mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS drops > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% year-over-year signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST rises > 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls.
